opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Establish a fast expansion while teching towards cybernetics core for early game units and upgrades.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high support count of 8236 games, indicating it is a common strategy.
The medoid key sequence is 'Prod_Gateway > Gas > Base > Tech_CyberneticsCore > Gas2', showing a gateway before expansion and a cybernetics core after expansion.
The profile shows a high technology investment (0.784) and moderate economy (0.567), with low ground (0.008) and air (0.0) investments, suggesting a tech-focused opening.
The distinctive flag 'has_cyber' has a rate of 0.895 compared to baseline 0.690, indicating cybernetics core is built more often than typical.
